title: Uniqueness of Branching through regular unipotent elements
summary: Let \(\mathrm G\) be a complex simple algebraic group and let \(\mathrm G_0\subset \mathrm G\) be a closed connected subgroup containing a regular unipotent element of \(\mathrm G\), with semisimple rank at least \(2\). Using Dynkin's classification, we prove that the restriction of an irreducible finite-dimensional representation of \(\mathrm G\) to \(\mathrm G_0\) determines the representation up to an outer automorphism of \(\mathrm G\) preserving \(\mathrm G_0\).
